description: This file defines the Perl package Git::SVN::Editor, implementing a commit driver for git-svn operations. It adapts SVN::Delta::Editor to facilitate communication between git trees and a Subversion repository, including methods for generating diffs, applying changes, and managing repository paths.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Editor
classes.description: A Perl module implementing a commit driver for git-svn, facilitating the translation of git tree differences into Subversion repository changes.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new Git::SVN::Editor object, initializing diff generation and repository parameters based on provided options.

methods.name: generate_diff
methods.description: Generates a diff between two git trees, returning a list of modifications.

methods.name: check_diff_paths
methods.description: Checks the repository paths for the diff modifications, determining their types.

methods.name: split_path
methods.description: Splits a path into directory and filename components.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Converts a repository-relative path to a full repository path, applying encoding if configured.

methods.name: url_path
methods.description: Constructs a full URL path for a given repository path, encoding special characters if necessary.

methods.name: rmdirs
methods.description: Removes directories from the repository based on recorded deletions.

methods.name: open_or_add_dir
methods.description: Opens an existing directory or adds a new one in the repository structure.

methods.name: ensure_path
methods.description: Ensures that a given path exists in the repository, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: glob2pat
methods.description: Converts a glob pattern to a regular expression.

methods.name: check_autoprop
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches a pattern for auto-properties and applies properties accordingly.

methods.name: apply_autoprops
methods.description: Applies auto-properties to a file based on configuration.

methods.name: check_attr
methods.description: Checks the value of a specific SVN attribute for a given path.

methods.name: apply_manualprops
methods.description: Applies manual SVN properties to a file based on current attributes.

methods.name: A
methods.description: Handles addition of a new file in the repository.

methods.name: C
methods.description: Handles copying (or adding) a file in the repository.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Deletes a file or directory entry from the repository.

methods.name: R
methods.description: Handles renaming or moving a file within the repository.

methods.name: M
methods.description: Handles modification of a file.

methods.name: T
methods.description: Handles toggling a file's symlink property.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Changes a file property.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Changes a directory property.

methods.name: _chg_file_get_blob
methods.description: Retrieves a blob object for a file, handling special modes and computing MD5.

methods.name: chg_file
methods.description: Applies changes to a file, including content and properties.

methods.name: D
methods.description: Handles deletion of a file or directory.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Finalizes the editing session, closing all open directories.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Aborts the current editing session.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources.

methods.name: apply_diff
methods.description: Main driver method that applies the generated diff to the repository.
